footer.tagline: A warm builder community for people who dream, connect, achieve, and help each other move forward.
footer.open_source_note: Open source, community-led, and built for people who ship.

home.hero_desc: GOUP is a warm circle of founders, engineers, researchers, creators, and community leaders who share help, ideas, jobs, projects, and honest introductions. Explore the Landscape to discover startups and community-built projects.
home.built_for_title: For people building in public and in community
home.built_for_desc: You do not need a big title. Bring curiosity, follow-through, and something useful to offer.
home.ai_founders_desc: Testing ideas, finding users, and learning what works.
home.open_source_desc: Looking for contributors, users, feedback, and friends.
home.product_builders_desc: Engineers, designers, operators, and curious makers.
home.community_hosts_desc: People who bring others together and make rooms warmer.
home.why_desc: The best parts of GOUP are simple: people answer, people introduce, people show up, and people celebrate when someone moves forward.
home.alliance_desc: Chapters, members, events, jobs, and projects in one trusted network.
home.events_desc: Join meetups, workshops, and gatherings across GOUP chapters.
home.groups_desc: Join a local chapter or interest group and start building.
home.latest_feed_desc: Fresh events, roles, ecosystem updates, and reading links from across the community.
